name: Advanced Intensive Care Unit (ICU & CCU)
description: 24/7 continuous cardiac and hemodynamic monitoring, dedicated mechanical ventilators, ECMO support, and 1:1 nurse-to-patient ratio.

name: Modular Operation Theatres (Modular OTs)
description: Laminar airflow theatres fitted with robotic surgical arms, intra-operative imaging, C-arm fluoroscopy, and sterile anesthesia stations.

name: Automated Diagnostic Pathology & Microbiology Lab
description: Fully automated clinical chemistry and hematology analyzers with barcoded tracking and instant digital reporting.

name: 24/7 In-House Hospital Pharmacy
description: Fully stocked dispensary maintaining cold chain biologicals, essential cardiac drugs, surgical disposables, and OTC items.

name: Luxury Patient Suites & Deluxe Rooms
description: Comfortable private and semi-private rooms equipped with motorized patient beds, guest sleeper sofa, ensuite baths, and nurse-call bells.

name: Modern Level-1 Emergency & Trauma Unit
description: Rapid response triage with dedicated resuscitation bays, mobile X-ray, point-of-care ultrasound, and direct OT access.

name: Dedicated Fleet of ACLS Ambulances
description: GPS-tracked Advance Cardiac Life Support ambulances staffed with certified paramedics and transport ventilators.

name: Spacious Visitor Lounge & Health Cafe
description: Calm, welcoming waiting areas with sanitized hydration stations, healthy dietary refreshments, and digital token queues.
